_README: Canonical list of SGLang source files that CAMA patches (full-file replacements).
Single source of truth for: deploy.py, upgrade-sglang.py, scripts/find_cama_patches.py,
scripts/sync_patches.py, scripts/check_drift.py, and the CI drift gate.
Source of truth for FILE CONTENT is the in-tree pre-packaged tree:
cama-connector/patches/<leaf> is a GENERATED mirror (regenerate via scripts/sync_patches.py).
deploy.py ships in the standalone connector zip, which has patches/ but NOT the full tree,
so patches/ must stay a real on-disk copy -- the CI drift gate guarantees it matches in-tree.
To verify this list is COMPLETE (no untracked patches), run scripts/find_cama_patches.py;
it diffs the in-tree tree against the pinned upstream base (UPSTREAM.txt) and flags any
differing file not listed here. That check is how schedule_policy / scheduler_metrics_mixin /
hicache_storage / hiradix_cache were discovered missing from the old hardcoded PATCH_MAP.

patches.why: +CAMA env vars (Envs entries consumed by the CAMA backend).
ThreadPoolExecutor zero-copy prefetch I/O + load-back backpressure (device headroom, load_tokens_pending). See docs/load-back-backpressure-audit.md.
Wire mem_quota into init_load_back() -- activates the load-back OOM guard. Change 4 of docs/load-back-backpressure-audit.md.
Push scheduler metrics (cache_hit_rate, token_usage, num_running_reqs, gen_throughput) to cache_controller.push_scheduler_metrics() for connector observability.
Add pp_rank/pp_size fields; fix upstream HiCacheStorageConfig prefix_keys default (None,) -> None (connector v1.14.1 coalesced prefix_keys fix).
HiRadix reconnect crash fix. See docs/hiradix-reconnect-crash-fix.md.
